title: Recipes v1: personal recipe box core loop
description: Ship the core loop: sign up/sign in, add a recipe (title/ingredients/steps/tags/timing), browse/search/filter your recipe list, view a recipe, edit/delete it. Scaffolded 2026-08-21 mirroring the Five Wonders/Houstory infra pattern (static HTML/CSS/JS, Supabase Postgres+Storage, GitHub Pages, bd).
acceptance_criteria: Can sign up, add a recipe with ingredients+steps+tags, see it in the list, filter by tag, search by title, view detail, edit it, and delete it - all working against the live Supabase project.
